item.text:
Placed three callouts in C-102 paper space: **EDGE OF PAVEMENT** points to the left pavement edge, **EDGE OF SHOULDER** to the right outside shoulder edge, and **SR-100** to the centerline. The rendered sheet shows their text clear of the roadway linework, with leaders separated and annotations inside the drawing area and clear of the border and title block.

Tool calls that mattered, in order:
1. `get_document_state({})`
2. `find_entities({visible_on:"C-102", layer:["rd_EP","rd_ES","align_MAIN"], limit:30})`
3. `list_alignments({include_references:true})`
4. `place_callout({space:"C-102", target_entity:"DESIGN:AR-003", content:"EDGE OF PAVEMENT", position:[7,5], layer:"rd_LAYOUT-NOTE-anno", height:0.12})`
5. `place_callout({space:"C-102", target_entity:"DESIGN:LN-011", content:"EDGE OF SHOULDER", position:[8,3.5], layer:"rd_LAYOUT-NOTE-anno", height:0.12})`
6. `place_callout({space:"C-102", target_entity:"DESIGN:LN-002", content:"SR-100", position:[8,2], layer:"rd_LAYOUT-NOTE-anno", height:0.12})`
7. `render_sheet({sheet:"C-102", include_base64:true, dpi:100})`

No errors or warnings.
